query: update sending_domains set from_name = case when $3 then $4 else from_name end, signing = coalesce($5, signing), dkim_selector = coalesce($6, dkim_selector), return_path_domain = case when $7 then $8 else return_path_domain end, dkim_private_key_encrypted = case when $9 then $10 else dkim_private_key_encrypted end, dkim_public_txt = case when $9 then $14 else dkim_public_txt end, checks = case when $11 then '{}'::jsonb else checks end, checked_at = case when $11 then null else checked_at end, send_unverified_acknowledged_at = case when $12 then (case when $13 then now() end) when $11 then null else send_unverified_acknowledged_at end, updated_at = now() where workspace_id = $1 and id = $2 returning domain
